title: Scheme overview
text: DTE scheme provides scholarship assistance to EBC/EWS students on eligible technical and professional courses through CAP.

title: Residency and income
text: Applicant must be an Indian national and Maharashtra domicile. Family total annual income must not exceed INR 800000.

title: Admission and university
text: Student must be bonafide and admitted to eligible professional technical course through CAP. Private and deemed universities are excluded under the scheme page.

title: Other scholarships and family
text: Applicant should not avail another scholarship or stipend. The scheme page limits family beneficiaries to two children subject to conditions and applicable GR updates.

title: Attendance and gap
text: Previous-semester attendance of at least 50 percent is required except first-semester fresh students. Education gap of two or more years is disallowed in the modeled conditions.

title: Scholarship benefits
text: Benefit percentages vary by scheme conditions and academic year. Benefit amount is distinct from preliminary eligibility.
